user.title: Add a reCamera
user.description: Enter a reCamera address. You can add a device before installing its application with reCamera Solution.

data_description.host: IP address of the camera, for example 192.168.1.50
data_description.device_name: Shown in the sidebar panel and on the device page
data_description.api_port: Port of the motion detection HTTP API (default 8080)
data_description.rtsp_stream: Stream published by the detector (default live0)

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or hostname.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the motion detection API. Check the address, that the program is running, and that Home Assistant can reach this network.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting to the camera.

init.title: reCamera options
init.description: Detection keeps working with the defaults; these settings tune bandwidth and notifications.

data.ha_notification: Show a Home Assistant notification on motion
data.push_enabled: Let the camera push events to Home Assistant
data.push_include_image: Include the snapshot in the pushed event

data_description.poll_interval: Used when the camera cannot push, and as a safety net. Motion always polls faster.
data_description.preview_fps: Higher is smoother but uses more bandwidth (each frame is a 720p JPEG).
data_description.snapshot_keep: Older motion frames are deleted from /config/www/recamera.
data_description.push_enabled: Faster alerts. Requires an internal or external URL in Home Assistant settings.

reset_background.name: Rebuild background
reset_background.description: Relearns the static scene. Use after moving the camera or changing the view.

device_id.name: Camera
device_id.description: The reCamera to rebuild the background for.

test_push.name: Send test alert
test_push.description: Makes the camera push one test event, including a snapshot, to verify the whole alert chain.
